cohort: 325 women who underwent labor and scheduled C-sections at the University Clinical Center of Kosovo
finding: The incidence of surgical site infections (SSI) after C-section was 9.85%, with previous cesarean section, co-morbidity, preoperative antibiotic use, and duration of operation being significant predictors.
mod_finding: The study investigated risk factors for surgical site infections after cesarean section, finding that previous cesarean section was associated with a 7.4-fold increased risk.
